messages:
Maya (PM): Brainstorm: add a dedicated smoke + incentive path for quantized model onboards. Rationale: quantized variants can change perf/cost/quality in non-obvious ways. Proposal: 72h smoke (shadow), 10d micro-canary, incentive credits for early adopters + clear pin/unpin flow. Thoughts?
Ishaan (ML): Agree. Quantized models need tokenization parity + output distribution checks. Propose gates: p95 <= 140ms, eval accuracy delta <= 2.5% relative, token_parity <= 2%. Also watch long-tail failure rate (LLF) threshold 0.5%. I'll own the bench.
Bea (Eng): Need infra constraints: force hardware tag list, disable dynamic quant autoswitch during canary, and set batch-size cap. I'll add an infra job template. @infra-bot please create canary job skeleton.
infra-bot: Created job: job/quant-smoke-canary-v1. Regions: us-west-2, asia-southeast-1. Alerts: latency_p95_exceed, llf_spike, infra_incident. Dashboard: /dash/quant-smoke-v1.
Rex (CS): Customer side: if we offer credits, need clear comms + defined pin TTL. Suggest opt-in pin 30 days with 30-day migration checklist. Also offer "early-adopter" credit of 10% platform credit for customers who opt into micro-canary and report feedback.
Clara (Sales): Sales + legal note: short AE blurb ready: "Opt into our quant micro-canary for early access, migration assistance, and a one-time credit." I'll loop legal.
Maya (PM): Draft smoke flow YAML (iter):
```
flow: quant_smoke_v1
stages:
  - name: shadow_smoke
    duration_hours: 72
    mode: shadow
  - name: micro_canary
    duration_days: 10
    traffic_pct: 5
bench_gates:
  latency_p95_ms: 140
  eval_accuracy_delta_pct: 2.5
  token_parity_pct: 2
  llf_rate_max_pct: 0.5
infra:
  hardware_tags: [g5.xlarge, g5.2xlarge]
  batch_size_cap: 8
pinning:
  tenant_opt_in: true
  ttl_days: 30
  auto_renew: false
incentives:
  early_adopter_credit_pct: 10
  credit_conditions: [opt-in micro_canary, feedback form submitted]
owners: [Maya, Ishaan, Bea, Rex]
```
Ishaan (ML): Add human spot-check: sample 20 responses, annotate for semantic drift/hallucination; >3 failures = fail. Also add embedding drift probe vs stable model.
Bea (Eng): I'll enforce hardware pins and add a suppression rule: pause canary if infra incident or if error rate doubles. ETA Wednesday.
Rex (CS): I'll draft the migration checklist and the credit redemption flow. Also will prepare a short FAQ about pins and what unpin means for SLAs.
Clara (Sales): Pinged legal for the AE blurb and credit terms. Will share draft in thread.
Maya (PM): Go/no-go owners = PM + Eng lead + ML lead + CS. Any veto holds admission. Action items: Bea add infra job + dashboard; Ishaan run bench; Rex docs + credit flow; Clara legal blurb. 30m sync Fri to review results.
Bea (Eng): Putting draft job + dashboard up now. Link: https://internal.dash/quant-smoke-v1 (will be live after infra job merge).
Ishaan (ML): Starting bench run, will post metrics summary here when done.
Rex (CS): Drafted migration checklist v0.1 and FAQ, will post Monday.
Maya (PM): Thanks all. If runway works, we'll make this the recommended path for any quantized catalog entries and tie the incentive to first-30-day telemetry feedback.
